title: Interface to the FWS NWRSpecies Occurrence Database API
text: Use get_species_list() retrieve species occurrence records optional filters region, refuge, taxonomic category, occurrence, ITIS TSN. Use download_species_list() retrieve CSV download endpoint, including large responses saved directly file. lookup functions return valid category occurrence values. Refuges can also selected name. Matching case-insensitive tolerant common variants “Kenai”, “kenai nwr”, “Kenai National Wildlife Refuge”: default, get_species_list() uses copy refuge name--code crosswalk included package. copy may reflect latest changes refuge names codes. retrieve current crosswalk FWS Unit API, run get_refuges() pass result crosswalk: public SpeciesListBasic method exposed public API. Sensitive species records Draft status never returned. Ambiguous refuge names return informative error listing candidates.
code: library(nwrspeciesr)  get_species_list(   region_number = 7,   category_name = "Bird",   occurrence = "Present" )  get_species_list(refuge_code = "FF07RKDK00") get_species_categories() get_species_occurrences()  download_species_list(   refuge_code = "FF07RKDK00",   rows_per_page = 130000,   path = "species-list.csv" ) get_species_list(refuge_name = "kenai nwr") current_refuges <- get_refuges() get_species_list(refuge_name = "Kenai", crosswalk = current_refuges)

title: Interface to the FWS NWRSpecies Occurrence Database API
text: package provides experimental functions authenticated write access internal SpeciesUpload API: get_upload_permissions(): list refuges writable API key. create_species_record(): create one record. create_species_records(): create 200 records one batch request. replace_species_record(): fully replace one existing record. replace_species_records(): fully replace 25 existing records one --nothing batch request. add_species_evidence(): add URL evidence record. Replacement full replacement, partial update. Include every field remain record, including status, refugeAccepted, isSensitive. Use single-record function one record; use batch function multiple records replaced together. Set API key NWRSPECIES_API_KEY environment variable, pass explicitly api_key. upload API defaults staging server https://staging-iris.fws.gov/APPS/SpeciesAPI/api/ service testing. functions can modify NWRSpecies data, verify permissions payloads sending requests. commit API keys scripts repositories. batch limits complete field validation rules, see function documentation upload user guide included repository.
code: Sys.setenv(NWRSPECIES_API_KEY = "your-api-key")  permissions <- get_upload_permissions()  created <- create_species_record(   list(     refugeCode = permissions$refugeCode[[1]],     taxonCode = 93710   ) )  add_species_evidence(list(   speciesId = created$speciesId,   url = "https://example.gov/report/123",   observationDate = "2026-05-14",   datePrecisionId = 1,   photograph = TRUE ))

title: nwrspeciesr 0.2.0
text: Fix package metadata update README documentation experimental authenticated upload API. Harden upload record evidence validation missing numeric values, invalid dates, unknown evidence fields. Add experimental authenticated upload edit functions internal SpeciesUpload API, including permissions, single-record batch create replace operations, evidence URLs. get_species_categories() get_species_occurrences() document API-version-specific lookup values. get_species_list() now reports mutual refuge_code/refuge_name errors package-specific class. Add file-backed downloads path argument download_species_list(). Add structured API response-schema errors programmatic error handling. Improve validation, refuge-name matching, API timeouts, retry handling. Add automated R CMD check coverage release development R Linux Windows. Add test coverage reporting reproducible README source document.
